rows.en:
"Heyyy, {a}~"
"Ah... Hosod..."
Before I could finish, Hosoda threw his arm around my shoulders again.
"If you're that curious, I'll tell you."
"Huh..."
"Arai said it's okay to tell you.
But in exchange, could you come with me for a bit?"
Hosoda and I headed for the restroom.{p}

Then he shoved me into a stall, came in after me, and locked the door.
(Ugh, gross!)
"We don't need a stall, do we? There's nobody in the restroom anyway."
I wanted to get out of this situation.
"It'll only take a sec~"
He sidled up close to me.
"After that, I asked Arai about it.
The next victim... it turns out it was me."
He said it without his smile ever slipping.
(He knows he's the sacrifice, so how can he keep smiling?)
It was eerie.
"But Arai told me there's one way, just one, to be saved.
Since you're my best friend, I was going to leave it."{p}

Hosoda looked a little angry as he said it.
"But, y'know, {a}, you don't seem to want that."
With that, he dropped his eyes toward the floor.
I followed Hosoda's gaze.
(Hm...?)
Something moved behind Hosoda's legs.
As I stared, a doll popped its face out.{p}

And its eyes met mine.
The doll came out from behind Hosoda and began stroking my body all over.
Carefully, so very carefully, it stroked me.
The doll smiled happily, looked over at Hosoda, and nodded.{p}

"Hosoda..."
"Looks like he's taken a liking to you.
The trade worked.
That doll says you, {a}, are the final sacrifice, the one who'll lift this school's curse.{p}

I'd rather live a long life, even if this school's curse never gets lifted!
No way am I throwing my life away over something like this.{p}

Do you want to trade too?
If you do, take your trade partner to the place where you can concentrate best.
If you're lucky, it'll work.
Huh? Well, because you only get one chance.............."
Hosoda's voice grew farther and farther away.{p}

And the doll wound itself tighter and tighter around my legs...
Yes, just like a puppy.{p}

...But {f:I|I} had bigger things on my mind.
A figure, visible behind Shindo.
It was Arai, no doubt about it.
Arai was walking along behind Shindo.
Then he shot a glance {f:our|our} way, turned the corner of the corridor, and vanished.{p}

"Where are you looking, {a}?"
Shindo turned around, as if bothered by where {f:my|my} eyes were.
But Arai had already vanished, so all he could do was look this way and that.
"What's the matter, {a}!"
"Just now, Arai walked right behind you and went around that corner."{p}
"What★"{p}

Shindo ran off toward where Arai had vanished.
{f:I|I} followed right after him.
When we rounded the corner, a shadow that looked like Arai was heading down the stairs.
{f:We|We} went down the stairs after it.{p}
We reached the bottom{f:, but|, but} Arai was gone.{p}

"What the hell, {a}?"
"{f:Sorry|Sorry}, somebody just hit my back..."
Before {f:I|I} could turn around, a voice came from behind me.
"What are you two up to?"{p}

"He was walking down the hall just now.
When our eyes met, he gave me a little hello.
Even before he came to the seven wonders meeting, I used to see him around here a lot."
"What, you knew him already?"
{f:I|I} stared at Fukuzawa in surprise.{p}

"Well, sort of. Our eyes would meet every now and then, so I thought maybe he had a crush on me. Heh heh.
So I figured he was a first-year like me, but turns out he's an upperclassman."
"Hey, {a}, maybe Arai really is a first-year."
Shindo turned to {f:me|me} as he said it.
{f:I see|Right}.
Whatever else he is, he's definitely a student at this school{f:.|.}
{f:I|I} nodded to Shindo without a word.
"Arai's a first-year?"
Fukuzawa looked puzzled.{p}

"Nah, there's no student named Arai in the second year.
I checked.
So I figure he's really a first-year.
But why the hell would he lie about it...
Anyway, let's go check out the first-year classes."
At Shindo's urging, the three of {f:us|us} went looking for Arai.{p}
"Eeeek! The doll..."
Suddenly, Fukuzawa screamed.{p}

The doll?
Shindo and {f:I|I} looked where she was pointing.
"I don't see anything."
Shindo rubbed his eyes.
"Me neither."
{f:I|I} couldn't see anything either.
"But it's there! It's right over there!"{p}
Fukuzawa said it as if terrified, and broke into a run.{p}

"Hey, Fukuzawa!"
{f:We|We} chased after her.
She can see the doll?
Then is she the next sacrifice{f:?|?}{p}

Fukuzawa dashed out into the schoolyard and headed for the old school building.
Then she sank down beside the building.{p}

"Hey, Fukuzawa, what's wrong?"
"I can see the doll. I'm the next victim."{p}

...Shindo and {f:I|I} looked at each other.
Considering everything that had happened, we couldn't flatly write off Arai's story yesterday as just a joke.
{f:But|But} yesterday, {f:I|I} was supposed to be the only one who could see it{f:|, though}...
"Shindo, what do we do..."
"Don't ask me..."
Shindo was at a loss too.
"I'm going to die..."
Fukuzawa murmured.{p}

When I happened to look up, I saw Arai at one of the old school building's windows.
"Arai..."
"Huh, Arai?"
Shindo said it as he followed {f:my|my} gaze.
"Let's go!"
He shouted that and went into the old school building.
I helped Fukuzawa to her feet, and {f:we|we} went after him.{p}

...Inside, the old school building was dim and chilly.
As I went on, my legs shaking, I found Shindo waiting at the far end of the corridor.{p}

"Shindo..."
"It's Arai."
Shindo jerked his chin toward a classroom nearby.
{f:We|We} went into the classroom.{p}

"Arai!"
Shindo bellowed.
But Arai didn't seem to hear him at all.
When Fukuzawa came into the classroom, he spoke, smiling eerily.
"I've been waiting for you."
Overwhelmed by the indescribable force he gave off, {f:we|we} stood frozen where we were.
"What's going on?"
{f:I|I} barely managed to get the words out.
But he went on talking without moving his eyes from Fukuzawa.
"Still, Fukuzawa, you mustn't bring along anything extra."
Anything extra?
...Does he mean Shindo and {f:me|me}{f:?|?}
It seemed {f:we|we} didn't even exist as far as he was concerned.{p}

"But since you've gone to the trouble of coming.
Why don't we play a game here?"
For the first time, Arai looked over at Shindo and {f:me|me}.
"Take a majority vote among yourselves and choose one person.
And let's make that one the final sacrifice."{p}

Arai transformed into the shape of the doll.
"Show me this thing you call human psychology."
The doll spoke in an eerie voice.
What {f:is|is} this?
What on earth am I supposed to do{f:|}......
The doll's face looked like it was smiling.
Does somebody have to be sacrificed{f:?|?}
{f:I|I} turned to look at Shindo.{p}

There was Fukuzawa, nestled close at Shindo's side.
The two of them were looking at {f:me|me}.
Looking at {f:me|me}...
{f:I|I} understood what my fate would be.{p}

{f:I|I} hesitated.
This probably has what {f:I|I} want to know written in it.
But I also have a nasty feeling that if I look at it, something terrible will happen.
...{f:My|My} bad feelings usually come true.
Lately I've felt that more than ever.
{f:I|I} picked up the diary.
The sepia-tinged diary gave off a faintly musty smell.{p}

"Ah..."
The diary slipped out of {f:my|my} hands.
And it fell open at a certain page.
{f:I|I} picked the diary up.
I almost found myself reading that page.
19XX, August...
The first part caught my eye.{p}

A quick swing of the principal's golf club grazed {f:me|me}.
Blood flowed from my torn earlobe.
What do I do★
On reflex, {f:I|I} grabbed an umbrella and held it ready.
The principal raised his club again and brought it swinging down at {f:me|me}.
Throwing my whole weight into it blindly, {f:I|I} thrust the umbrella forward.{p}

The tip of the umbrella was stuck in the principal's chest.
{f:I|I} let go of the umbrella.
...I'd done it.
In my head, guilt and relief at being saved were tangled together.
The principal took hold of the umbrella and pulled it out.
Then blood gushed from the wound like a fountain and rained down on {f:me|me}...
He crumpled to the floor.
...Is it over{f:?|?}
As I stood there in a daze, thinking that, thunder roared.
It had grown dark outside the window.
And little by little, the principal's office was swallowed by darkness.{p}
Just then, the principal's office window shattered and wind blew in.{p}
Through the window, a doll floating in midair quietly drew closer.{p}
Once inside the room, the doll changed into the shape of Arai.{p}

{f:I|I} fled the principal's office.
I don't remember which way I went.{p}

...From the next day on, life went back to normal.
The doll hasn't appeared since that day either.
The days went on until the whole thing almost seemed like a dream.
Summer vacation is about to end.
I have to get the homework I've been putting off done.
{f:My|My} mind had settled down enough to think things like that.
It's proof that things are peaceful{f:.|.}{p}

...And the new term began.
When {f:I|I} got to school, I stopped for a moment at the gate.
That was all a dream{f:.|.}
Thinking that, I pushed myself to walk in.
It's fine.
It's just the same old school{f:, isn't it|, isn't it}?
I murmured it to myself over and over.
At the opening ceremony, a new principal was introduced.
{f:Apparently|I heard} the former principal was taking a leave of absence for medical treatment.{p}
"A-Arai..."{p}
The golf club smashed through the shelf's glass with tremendous force.{p}

(What do I do...)
The principal swung his golf club around again, and {f:I|I} was driven back against the wardrobe.
"Heh heh heh..."
The golf club came down.
(There's nowhere left to run{f:|})
Thinking that, I shut my eyes and braced myself for the end.{p}
"Shoji..."

"It's for you... it's all to bring you back to life.
If I offer up just one more sacrifice, you can come back to life."
"Thank you, Dad.
But it's all right now.
I was happy that you'd go this far for me."{p}

The principal raised his club and, stepping around the chair, quietly closed in.
The only place left to escape to was under the desk.
The moment the principal brought the club down, {f:I|I} dove under the desk.
For now, I'd escaped the club.
{f:But|But} I knew there was nowhere left to run.
(Ah...)
There was something under the desk.
{f:I|I} turned around.{p}

I-It's the doll{f:|}......
The doll's eyes glowed eerily.
{f:I|I} backed away.
I {f:slammed|bumped} into something, and looked forward again.{p}

There were the principal's feet.
It was over.{p}
When I turned around, the doll was closing in on me.{p}

The doll threw its arms around me as if to hug me and bit into the side of {f:my|my} neck.
My consciousness slowly slipped away.
What a {f:life|life}......
And the last thing I saw was Arai's expressionless face.{p}
Quietly wait for death to come
Try my best to connect with the doll
Try talking to someone about it
Try going to the school once more
Whatever I do, it's all wasted effort
Just then, I suddenly remembered Arai's story.{p}
